conversations.title: Welcome to the Festival
conversations.description: Arrive at the sagra and get oriented.

messages.text: Benvenuti alla nostra sagra! Vi piace l'atmosfera?
messages.english: Welcome to our festival! Do you like the atmosphere?

choices.text: Sì, è bellissima! C'è molta gente stasera.
choices.english: Yes, it's beautiful! There are many people tonight.
choices.feedback: Great! Italian festivals are known for their lively atmosphere.

choices.text: No, è troppo calda. Vorrei andare a casa.
choices.english: No, it's too hot. I would like to go home.
choices.feedback: A bit negative! Sagas are usually enjoyed in the cool evening.

choices.text: Dove sono le chiavi? Ho fretta di entrare.
choices.english: Where are the keys? I'm in a hurry to enter.
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario! You are at a festival, not an apartment.

messages.text: È vero, quest'anno abbiamo molti visitatori. Avete già visto il palco principale?
messages.english: It's true, this year we have many visitors. Have you already seen the main stage?

choices.text: No, non ancora. Dove si trova esattamente?
choices.english: No, not yet. Where is it located exactly?
choices.feedback: Perfect for getting directions to the main events.

choices.text: Sì, è molto grande. Mi piace la musica.
choices.english: Yes, it's very big. I like the music.
choices.feedback: The host asked if you've seen it, not for your opinion yet!

choices.text: Vorrei comprare un biglietto per il treno.
choices.english: I would like to buy a train ticket.
choices.feedback: You are at a festival, there is no train station here!

messages.text: È in fondo alla piazza, vicino alla chiesa. La musica inizia tra poco.
messages.english: It's at the end of the square, near the church. The music starts soon.

choices.text: Ottimo! Cosa mi consiglia di fare prima?
choices.english: Great! What do you recommend I do first?
choices.feedback: Asking locals for recommendations is a great way to explore.

choices.text: Peccato! Non mi piace ascoltare la musica.
choices.english: Too bad! I don't like listening to music.
choices.feedback: festivals are mostly about music and food!

choices.text: Grazie! Dove posso trovare un medico ora?
choices.english: Thanks! Where can I find a doctor now?
choices.feedback: Hopefully you don't need a doctor at a festival!

messages.text: Le consiglio di fare un giro tra le bancarelle dell'artigianato. Sono molto belle.
messages.english: I recommend you take a walk among the craft stalls. They are very beautiful.

choices.text: Mi sembra un'ottima idea. Dove sono?
choices.english: That seems like a great idea. Where are they?
choices.feedback: Following up on a suggestion is very natural.

choices.text: Preferisco mangiare qualcosa subito. Ho fame.
choices.english: I prefer to eat something immediately. I'm hungry.
choices.feedback: A bit blunt, though food is a big part of festivals too.

choices.text: Posso avere un asciugamano pulito, per favore?
choices.english: Can I have a clean towel, please?
choices.feedback: You are on the street, not in a hotel!

messages.text: Le bancarelle sono lungo la strada principale. Buon divertimento!
messages.english: The stalls are along the main street. Have fun!

choices.text: Grazie mille per l'aiuto! A più tardi.
choices.english: Thanks a lot for the help! See you later.
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the conversation.

choices.text: Arrivederci, vado subito a vedere.
choices.english: Goodbye, I'm going to see right away.
choices.feedback: A bit formal for a casual festival chat.

choices.text: Buonanotte, vado a dormire in hotel.
choices.english: Goodnight, I'm going to sleep in the hotel.
choices.feedback: The night is still young at a sagra!

messages.text: Aspetti! Vuole una mappa dell'evento? È molto utile.
messages.english: Wait! Do you want a map of the event? It's very useful.

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Mi serve proprio una mappa.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. I really need a map.
choices.feedback: Great! Maps are always helpful for tourists.

choices.text: No, non mi piacciono le mappe.
choices.english: No, I don't like maps.
choices.feedback: You might get lost without a map!

choices.text: Dove posso comprare un biglietto aereo?
choices.english: Where can I buy a plane ticket?
choices.feedback: Wrong domain! You're at a festival, not an airport.

messages.text: Eccola. La mappa mostra dove passa la sfilata storica.
messages.english: Here it is. The map shows where the historical parade passes.

choices.text: Perfetto, grazie. A che ora passa la sfilata?
choices.english: Perfect, thanks. What time does the parade pass?
choices.feedback: Asking about the schedule is a good next step.

choices.text: Non mi interessa la sfilata.
choices.english: I'm not interested in the parade.
choices.feedback: The parade is the highlight of the festival!

choices.text: Voglio prenotare un tavolo al ristorante.
choices.english: I want to book a table at the restaurant.
choices.feedback: You're in a square, not at a restaurant.

messages.text: La sfilata è la parte più importante. Le piacciono le tradizioni?
messages.english: The parade is the most important part. Do you like traditions?

choices.text: Sì, molto. Mi piace scoprire la cultura locale.
choices.english: Yes, very much. I like discovering local culture.
choices.feedback: Showing interest in local traditions is great for learning.

choices.text: No, preferisco guardare la televisione.
choices.english: No, I prefer watching television.
choices.feedback: That's a bit boring for a festival attendee!

choices.text: Dov'è la chiave della mia camera?
choices.english: Where is the key to my room?
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario! You are at a festival, not an apartment.

messages.text: Allora le consiglio di andare in piazza presto per vedere bene.
messages.english: Then I recommend you go to the square early to see well.

choices.text: Grazie del consiglio. Ci vado subito.
choices.english: Thanks for the advice. I'm going there right away.
choices.feedback: Good plan! The square fills up quickly.

choices.text: No, preferisco restare qui a sedermi.
choices.english: No, I prefer to stay here and sit down.
choices.feedback: You'll miss the best view if you stay here!

choices.text: Quanto costa l'affitto dell'appartamento?
choices.english: How much is the rent for the apartment?
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario! You are at a festival, not an apartment.

messages.text: Spero che passi una bella serata. Ci vediamo in giro!
messages.english: I hope you have a nice evening. See you around!

choices.text: Grazie mille! Buona serata anche a lei.
choices.english: Thanks a lot! Have a good evening too.
choices.feedback: A polite and friendly way to end the conversation.

choices.text: Arrivederci. Vado via adesso.
choices.english: Goodbye. I'm leaving now.
choices.feedback: A bit abrupt for a nice chat.

choices.text: Dov'è la fermata dell'autobus per Roma?
choices.english: Where is the bus stop for Rome?
choices.feedback: You're at a festival, the bus stop is far from here!

conversations.title: At the Food Stall
conversations.description: Order a local specialty at one of the many stands.

messages.text: Buonasera! Volete assaggiare la nostra specialità locale?
messages.english: Good evening! Do you want to taste our local specialty?

choices.text: Sì, volentieri! Di che cosa si tratta?
choices.english: Yes, gladly! What is it about?
choices.feedback: Great way to show interest in local food.

choices.text: No, grazie. Non ho fame in questo momento.
choices.english: No, thanks. I'm not hungry right now.
choices.feedback: You'll miss out on the best part of the sagra!

choices.text: Qual è il numero del mio volo per Roma?
choices.english: What is the number of my flight to Rome?
choices.feedback: You are at a food stand, not the airport!

messages.text: È un piatto di pasta con tartufo fresco. È delizioso!
messages.english: It's a pasta dish with fresh truffle. It's delicious!

choices.text: Sembra fantastico. Quanto costa un piatto?
choices.english: It sounds fantastic. How much does a plate cost?
choices.feedback: Asking for the price is essential at a market.

choices.text: Non mi piace il tartufo. Avete altro?
choices.english: I don't like truffle. Do you have anything else?
choices.feedback: It's okay to have preferences, but be polite.

choices.text: Vorrei prenotare una camera singola, grazie.
choices.english: I would like to book a single room, thank you.
choices.feedback: This is a food stall, not a hotel reception.

messages.text: Costa solo dieci euro. È un prezzo speciale per la festa.
messages.english: It costs only ten euros. It's a special price for the festival.

choices.text: Va bene, ne prendo uno. Posso pagare con carta?
choices.english: Okay, I'll take one. Can I pay by card?
choices.feedback: Checking for payment methods is very practical.

choices.text: È troppo caro per me. Vado via.
choices.english: It's too expensive for me. I'm leaving.
choices.feedback: Ten euros for truffle pasta is actually a bargain!

choices.text: Ecco il mio passaporto. Posso entrare?
choices.english: Here is my passport. Can I enter?
choices.feedback: You don't need a passport to buy pasta!

messages.text: Certamente, accettiamo tutte le carte. Ecco a lei, buon appetito!
messages.english: Certainly, we accept all cards. Here you go, enjoy your meal!

choices.text: Grazie mille! Sembra davvero molto buono.
choices.english: Thanks a lot! It really looks very good.
choices.feedback: Politeness is always appreciated.

choices.text: Dove posso sedermi per mangiare la pasta?
choices.english: Where can I sit to eat the pasta?
choices.feedback: Good question, but say thanks first!

choices.text: Vorrei cambiare i soldi in banca ora.
choices.english: I would like to change money at the bank now.
choices.feedback: The bank is closed during the festival!

messages.text: Ci sono dei tavoli liberi dietro lo stand. Prego!
messages.english: There are some free tables behind the stand. You're welcome!

choices.text: Perfetto, vado subito a sedermi. Grazie!
choices.english: Perfect, I'm going to sit down right away. Thanks!
choices.feedback: You're all set to enjoy your local specialty.

choices.text: Grazie per il consiglio. Buona serata!
choices.english: Thanks for the advice. Have a good evening!
choices.feedback: A bit formal, but acceptable.

choices.text: Non trovo il mio bagaglio. Mi aiuti.
choices.english: I can't find my luggage. Help me.
choices.feedback: You are still at the food stall, no luggage here!

messages.text: Aspetti, vuole anche qualcosa da bere? Abbiamo vino locale.
messages.english: Wait, do you also want something to drink? We have local wine.

choices.text: Sì, volentieri. Un bicchiere di vino rosso, grazie.
choices.english: Yes, gladly. A glass of red wine, thanks.
choices.feedback: Perfect! Red wine pairs well with truffle pasta.

choices.text: No, grazie. Preferisco un bicchiere di acqua fredda.
choices.english: No, thanks. I prefer a glass of cold water.
choices.feedback: Water is always a good choice, but wine is the local specialty!

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Avete anche della birra alla spina?
choices.english: Yes, thanks. Do you also have beer on tap?
choices.feedback: We only have wine and water here today!

messages.text: È un vino rosso delle nostre colline. Ne vuole un bicchiere?
messages.english: It's a red wine from our hills. Do you want a glass?

choices.text: Sì, sembra ottimo. Quanto costa?
choices.english: Yes, it sounds great. How much does it cost?
choices.feedback: Good to check the price of drinks too.

choices.text: No, preferisco una birra fredda.
choices.english: No, I prefer a cold beer.
choices.feedback: We only have wine and water here.

choices.text: Vorrei un asciugamano per la doccia.
choices.english: I would like a towel for the shower.
choices.feedback: Wrong place for bathroom supplies!

messages.text: Costa tre euro. Il vino è perfetto con il tartufo.
messages.english: It costs three euros. The wine is perfect with the truffle.

choices.text: Va bene, ecco tre euro. Grazie.
choices.english: Okay, here are three euros. Thanks.
choices.feedback: A fair price for local wine.

choices.text: È troppo caro per un bicchiere.
choices.english: It's too expensive for a glass.
choices.feedback: Actually, it's a very good price for artisanal wine.

choices.text: Il mio passaporto è scaduto oggi.
choices.english: My passport expired today.
choices.feedback: What does that have to do with wine?

messages.text: Vuole un tovagliolo o del pane con la pasta?
messages.english: Do you want a napkin or some bread with the pasta?

choices.text: Sì, un tovagliolo, per favore.
choices.english: Yes, a napkin, please.
choices.feedback: Napkins are always useful when eating pasta.

choices.text: No, non mangio mai il pane.
choices.english: No, I never eat bread.
choices.feedback: In Italy, bread is usually served with everything!

choices.text: Dove posso noleggiare una bicicletta?
choices.english: Where can I rent a bike?
choices.feedback: You're at a food stall, not a bike rental shop.

messages.text: Buon appetito! Mi faccia sapere se serve altro.
messages.english: Enjoy your meal! Let me know if you need anything else.

choices.text: Grazie di tutto! La pasta è deliziosa.
choices.english: Thanks for everything! The pasta is delicious.
choices.feedback: A great way to finish the interaction.

choices.text: Arrivederci, ho finito di mangiare.
choices.english: Goodbye, I've finished eating.
choices.feedback: A bit too quick! Enjoy the moment.

choices.text: A che ora parte il mio volo?
choices.english: What time does my flight leave?
choices.feedback: No flights at the sagra!

conversations.title: Parade Times
conversations.description: Ask for details about the historical parade.

messages.text: Scusi, sa a che ora inizia la sfilata storica?
messages.english: Excuse me, do you know what time the historical parade starts?

choices.text: Certo! La sfilata inizia alle nove in punto.
choices.english: Sure! The parade starts at nine o'clock sharp.
choices.feedback: Providing the correct time clearly.

choices.text: Non lo so, deve chiedere all'ufficio.
choices.english: I don't know, you must ask at the office.
choices.feedback: Not very helpful if you're the one supposed to know!

choices.text: La lezione di italiano inizia alle otto.
choices.english: The Italian lesson starts at eight.
choices.feedback: Wrong topic! We're talking about the parade.

messages.text: Ah, perfetto. E da dove parte il corteo?
messages.english: Ah, perfect. And where does the procession start from?

choices.text: Parte dall'ingresso del borgo antico.
choices.english: It starts from the entrance of the ancient village.
choices.feedback: Giving precise location information.

choices.text: Parte dalla stazione dei treni centrali.
choices.english: It starts from the central train station.
choices.feedback: Usually, parades are in the historic center.

choices.text: Parte dall'ospedale della città vicina.
choices.english: It starts from the hospital in the nearby city.
choices.feedback: That's a very long parade!

messages.text: Bisogna pagare un biglietto per vedere la sfilata?
messages.english: Do you have to pay for a ticket to see the parade?

choices.text: No, è totalmente gratuita per tutti.
choices.english: No, it is totally free for everyone.
choices.feedback: Correct. Most town parades are free to watch.

choices.text: Sì, costa venti euro per gli adulti.
choices.english: Yes, it costs twenty euros for adults.
choices.feedback: That would be very expensive for a town parade!

choices.text: Serve la ricetta del medico per entrare.
choices.english: You need a doctor's prescription to enter.
choices.feedback: That makes no sense for a public event!

messages.text: Che bella notizia! Ci sono molti figuranti quest'anno?
messages.english: What good news! Are there many participants this year?

choices.text: Sì, ci sono più di cento persone in costume.
choices.english: Yes, there are more than a hundred people in costume.
choices.feedback: Confirming the scale of the event.

choices.text: No, quest'anno la sfilata è molto piccola.
choices.english: No, this year the parade is very small.
choices.feedback: A bit disappointing for a visitor!

choices.text: Il wifi è gratuito in tutto il palazzo.
choices.english: The wifi is free throughout the building.
choices.feedback: We are outside talking about a parade!

messages.text: Sarà sicuramente uno spettacolo meraviglioso.
messages.english: It will surely be a wonderful show.

choices.text: Lo spero proprio! Buona visione allora.
choices.english: I really hope so! Enjoy the show then.
choices.feedback: A polite way to conclude the info exchange.

choices.text: Non vedo l'ora di vederla. A dopo!
choices.english: I can't wait to see it. See you later!
choices.feedback: Wait, you are the local providing info!

choices.text: Mi serve una medicina per il mal di testa.
choices.english: I need a medicine for a headache.
choices.feedback: Off-topic again!

messages.text: La sfilata include molti cavalli e sbandieratori. È molto rumorosa!
messages.english: The parade includes many horses and flag-wavers. It's very loud!

choices.text: Che bello! Mi piacciono molto i cavalli.
choices.english: How nice! I like horses very much.
choices.feedback: Horses are a traditional part of many Italian parades.

choices.text: Troppo rumore! Non mi piace.
choices.english: Too much noise! I don't like it.
choices.feedback: Festivals are often loud and lively!

choices.text: Ho bisogno di una medicina per lo stomaco.
choices.english: I need a medicine for my stomach.
choices.feedback: Wrong topic! We're talking about the parade.

messages.text: Ha una macchina fotografica? Dovrebbe fare delle foto ai costumi.
messages.english: Do you have a camera? You should take some photos of the costumes.

choices.text: Sì, la prendo subito. I costumi sono bellissimi.
choices.english: Yes, I'll get it right away. The costumes are beautiful.
choices.feedback: The costumes are very photogenic.

choices.text: No, non mi piace fare foto.
choices.english: No, I don't like taking photos.
choices.feedback: You'll miss out on great memories!

choices.text: Dov'è la lavanderia più vicina?
choices.english: Where is the nearest laundry?
choices.feedback: We are outside, far from any laundry.

messages.text: I costumi sono fatti a mano dalle donne del paese. Sono molto antichi.
messages.english: The costumes are handmade by the women of the village. They are very old.

choices.text: Incredibile! È una tradizione meravigliosa.
choices.english: Incredible! It's a wonderful tradition.
choices.feedback: Local craftsmanship is highly valued in Italy.

choices.text: Non mi interessano i vestiti vecchi.
choices.english: I'm not interested in old clothes.
choices.feedback: These are historical costumes, not just old clothes!

choices.text: Quanto costa un biglietto per il museo?
choices.english: How much is a ticket for the museum?
choices.feedback: The parade is on the street, not in a museum.

messages.text: Dopo la sfilata, ci sono anche i fuochi d'artificio.
messages.english: After the parade, there are also fireworks.

choices.text: Fantastico! A che ora iniziano i fuochi?
choices.english: Fantastic! What time do the fireworks start?
choices.feedback: Fireworks are the perfect way to end a festival.

choices.text: Ho paura dei fuochi d'artificio.
choices.english: I'm afraid of fireworks.
choices.feedback: They are quite far away, so it's safe!

choices.text: Vorrei un cappuccino e un cornetto.
choices.english: I would like a cappuccino and a croissant.
choices.feedback: It's late at night, too late for breakfast food!

messages.text: Iniziano a mezzanotte. Sarà una serata bellissima!
messages.english: They start at midnight. It will be a beautiful evening!

choices.text: Non vedo l'ora! Grazie per le informazioni.
choices.english: I can't wait! Thanks for the information.
choices.feedback: A great way to conclude the information exchange.

choices.text: È troppo tardi per me. Vado a dormire.
choices.english: It's too late for me. I'm going to sleep.
choices.feedback: You'll miss the best part!

choices.text: Dov'è il binario per il treno?
choices.english: Where is the platform for the train?
choices.feedback: The station is far from the village center.

conversations.title: Buying Crafts
conversations.description: Purchase a handmade souvenir from a local artist.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Cerca un regalo o un ricordo della festa?
messages.english: Good morning! Are you looking for a gift or a souvenir of the festival?

choices.text: Sì, cerco qualcosa di fatto a mano.
choices.english: Yes, I'm looking for something handmade.
choices.feedback: Artisan products are the best souvenirs.

choices.text: No, sto solo guardando le bancarelle.
choices.english: No, I'm just looking at the stalls.
choices.feedback: Fine, but you might miss something unique.

choices.text: Cerco il binario per il treno di Milano.
choices.english: I'm looking for the platform for the Milan train.
choices.feedback: You are at a craft market stall!

messages.text: Abbiamo queste bellissime ceramiche dipinte a mano. Le piacciono?
messages.english: We have these beautiful hand-painted ceramics. Do you like them?

choices.text: Sono splendide! Qual è il prezzo di questo vaso?
choices.english: They are splendid! What is the price of this vase?
choices.feedback: Asking for the price of a specific item is good.

choices.text: Preferisco il legno. Avete oggetti in legno?
choices.english: I prefer wood. Do you have wooden objects?
choices.feedback: They explicitly showed you ceramics!

choices.text: Vorrei affittare una bicicletta per un giorno.
choices.english: I would like to rent a bike for a day.
choices.feedback: Wrong place for bike rentals!

messages.text: Il vaso costa quindici euro. È un pezzo unico.
messages.english: The vase costs fifteen euros. It's a unique piece.

choices.text: Lo prendo! Potete fare una confezione regalo?
choices.english: I'll take it! Can you do a gift wrapping?
choices.feedback: Decisive and practical for a gift.

choices.text: È un po' caro. Mi fa uno sconto?
choices.english: It's a bit expensive. Can you give me a discount?
choices.feedback: Bargaining is less common for small artisan pieces.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno più vicino in questo hotel?
choices.english: Where is the nearest bathroom in this hotel?
choices.feedback: You are at a festival stall, not an hotel!

messages.text: Certamente, lo incarto subito con cura.
messages.english: Certainly, I'll wrap it carefully right away.

choices.text: Grazie, è molto gentile da parte sua.
choices.english: Thanks, that's very kind of you.
choices.feedback: A nice way to acknowledge the service.

choices.text: Va bene, ecco i soldi contanti.
choices.english: Okay, here is the cash.
choices.feedback: A bit abrupt, but effective.

choices.text: Ho perso il portafoglio in aeroporto.
choices.english: I lost my wallet at the airport.
choices.feedback: Then you can't buy the vase!

messages.text: Ecco a lei. Spero che il regalo piaccia!
messages.english: Here you go. I hope the gift is liked!

choices.text: Sicuramente! Grazie ancora e buona giornata.
choices.english: Surely! Thanks again and have a good day.
choices.feedback: A perfect closing for a successful purchase.

choices.text: Grazie a lei. Il vaso è bellissimo.
choices.english: Thanks to you. The vase is beautiful.
choices.feedback: Good, but don't forget the farewell.

choices.text: Devo andare a lavorare in ufficio adesso.
choices.english: I have to go to work in the office now.
choices.feedback: Enjoy the festival instead!

messages.text: Se le interessa, abbiamo anche dei piccoli magneti dipinti a mano.
messages.english: If you are interested, we also have small hand-painted magnets.

choices.text: Oh, sono carini! Posso vederli?
choices.english: Oh, they are cute! Can I see them?
choices.feedback: Magnets are great small souvenirs.

choices.text: No, non mi servono i magneti.
choices.english: No, I don't need magnets.
choices.feedback: They are very small and don't take up space!

choices.text: Vorrei prenotare un tavolo per cena.
choices.english: I would like to book a table for dinner.
choices.feedback: You're at a craft stall, not a restaurant.

messages.text: Sono leggeri da portare in valigia. Ne vuole vedere uno?
messages.english: They are light to carry in a suitcase. Do you want to see one?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Questo con la chiesa è molto bello.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. This one with the church is very beautiful.
choices.feedback: A nice choice representing the village.

choices.text: No, preferisco comprare una maglietta.
choices.english: No, I prefer to buy a t-shirt.
choices.feedback: We don't have t-shirts here, only ceramics and magnets.

choices.text: C'è il wifi gratuito qui vicino?
choices.english: Is there free wifi nearby?
choices.feedback: Not at the craft market!

messages.text: Ogni magnete rappresenta un angolo diverso del nostro borgo.
messages.english: Each magnet represents a different corner of our village.

choices.text: È un'idea bellissima per un ricordo.
choices.english: It's a beautiful idea for a souvenir.
choices.feedback: Souvenirs help you remember your trip.

choices.text: Preferisco i magneti delle grandi città.
choices.english: I prefer magnets from big cities.
choices.feedback: Small villages have more unique items!

choices.text: Ho perso le chiavi dell'appartamento.
choices.english: I lost the keys to the apartment.
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario! You are at a festival stall.

messages.text: Dato che ha comprato il vaso, le regalo un magnete!
messages.english: Since you bought the vase, I'll give you a magnet as a gift!

choices.text: Davvero? Grazie mille, è molto gentile!
choices.english: Really? Thanks a lot, you're very kind!
choices.feedback: It's always nice to get a small gift.

choices.text: Non lo voglio, grazie lo stesso.
choices.english: I don't want it, thanks anyway.
choices.feedback: It's free! Why not take it?

choices.text: Dove posso trovare un taxi per l'aeroporto?
choices.english: Where can I find a taxi for the airport?
choices.feedback: There are no taxis in the middle of the sagra.

messages.text: È un piccolo ricordo della sua visita. Grazie e arrivederci!
messages.english: It's a small souvenir of your visit. Thank you and goodbye!

choices.text: Grazie ancora di tutto. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Thanks again for everything. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: A perfect ending to your shopping experience.

choices.text: Va bene, me ne vado ora.
choices.english: Okay, I'm leaving now.
choices.feedback: A bit rude after receiving a gift!

choices.text: Quanto costa il check-out in hotel?
choices.english: How much is the check-out in the hotel?
choices.feedback: You're at a festival stall, not an hotel!
